fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is defeated by the existing affine-closure witness, independently of splitter degree or path simplicity. Every incompatibility-walk product vanishes on every matching, so an odd XOR of legal lifted matchings remains shell-free; escape requires a non-linear-span construction or a controlled nonzero legal shell, neither supplied.

Proposal 1 also lacks polynomial asymptotic accounting: symbolic ANF expansion of degree r=Theta(log q) can require k^r monomials, and polynomially many walks require a missing bounded-incompatibility-degree reduction. Testing r<=6 would only reconfirm a known hostile witness, not discriminate the claimed scaling mechanism.

Proposal 2 occupies the surviving O7 opening but does not specify a deterministic folding matrix: matroid canonicalization, recursive tie-breaking, butterfly directions, retained outputs, and output budget are undefined. No polynomial-time canonicalization argument, universal sparse-YES bound, or all-mixed-word soundness invariant is given, so a favorable tiny search could be post-selection rather than evidence for this construction.

Proposal 3 supplies neither formula-derived voltages nor a fixed presentation-to-binary-matrix rule. Regular-representation Fox boundaries remain linear, so the known affine-closure problem persists unless every illegal cover is proved to enter a nontrivial twisted class; universal completeness may instead force the single-valued voltage system into O4 gauge triviality.

Proposal 4 at every tested fixed degree is covered by O1 and fixed-scope pseudo-evaluation obstructions O3. Growing degree is the only stated escape, but no polynomial bound on clause-connected monomials or syzygies is proved, and slack coordinates reintroduce O5-style exact repairs and an uncontrolled YES baseline.

Proposal 5 communicates through polynomial-width trellis states and linear sketches, hence either uses bounded wire/tableau interfaces covered by O2 or relies on an unspecified global checksum. Shared literal columns do not by themselves prevent independent path-flow splices; escape requires an explicit global coupling matrix with an all-mixed-flow theorem.

Proposal 6 remains inside O5. Any original signed exact-fiber repair can be copied diagonally through a Lawrence lift with only linear overhead, matching the O(rq) legal baseline and precluding the proposed superlinear ratio; only an asymmetric non-diagonal mutation could escape.

O8 is only a conditional transfer for an explicit binary H,t. It does not compile Fox transport, Macaulay evaluations, trellis semantics, or integer Lawrence success into syndrome decoding, and the integer-only branch of proposal 6 misses the required exact route.
evidence: The Schur-walk verifier already found shell-free illegal mixed words of costs 6 and 9 on all-eight and twisted three-matching instances. Cycle erasure and splitter expansion cannot alter the fact that an XOR of zero-shell legal lifts has zero shell.

The exchange-quotient verifier found 32 instances where an illegal odd cover lies in the affine span of legal matchings, including weight 5 versus legal weight 3. This directly attacks proposals 1 and 3 and any other linear classifier of all legal witnesses.

Existing exact tests of code-dependent generator folds, modular Kronecker folds, sparse hashes, and frozen sampled product folds all lost the gap or overfit; parity-check simplification is rigorously vacuous on the current tensor family. These results do not kill every dense fold, but proposal 2 gives no sufficiently defined new map to test.

The bounded-signature theorem guarantees cube cancellation for fixed-degree Macaulay features, while local-view verifiers exhibit odd-holonomy pseudoassignments. A pass at degrees 2 through 4 would therefore not support the required growing-degree asymptotic claim.

Prior tableau and shared-branch experiments produced support-three or rectangle splices, directly matching proposal 5's trellis interfaces. No verifier evidence is supplied for its proposed global checksum.

Direct integer 3DM and variable-projection verifiers prove only additive squared gaps q versus q+2 and 12 versus 14, including signed repairs. Lawrence replication does not remove this common linear baseline.
No supplied verifier implements any of the six proposed matrices. Thus none of their claimed expected moves currently has experimental support.
next_experiment: None as written. Reopen only proposal 2 after supplying one fully frozen polynomial-time matrix algorithm, including canonical tie-breaking and output budget; then exactly enumerate every mixed image word on all tiny YES/NO reduced squares, all-eight, affine-closure, odd-holonomy, and all relabelings, and kill unless the precommitted map strictly improves the unfurled worst-YES/best-NO rank exponent.
